items.title: Herb Morand Interview, 1950-03-12
items.q: Well, he inspired me a whole lot. And, uh, used to show me a few things on the trumpet.

ctx.x: Well, do you remember many of the trombones from that time? Well, no, I don't, I don't remember many of them. I mean, you spoke of Jack Carey, do you remember Ori? Was he playing down here then? No, he had left too, I think. Or, uh... Did you ever have anything to do with Professor Mineta, Manuel Mineta? Yeah, Old Horse they called him, eh? Yeah.
Well, he inspired me a whole lot. And, uh, used to show me a few things on the trumpet. Yeah.
Was he more of a teacher or a regular musician? He's still teaching today, yeah. Must be pretty old.
